title: Flatten Yield
statement: Implement `solve(rows)`. `rows` is a list of lists of integers. Yield every inner item once, in order, and return the list of yields. Do not flatten further. Empty inner lists contribute nothing.
hints: For each inner list, yield from it or loop and yield each item.
Do not wrap items in another list.
Materialize at the end for the return value.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: yield from walks an inner iterable and yields its items one by one.

editorial: yield from walks an inner iterable and yields its items one by one. That is one-level flatten as a generator. Building the full list inside the producer throws away the reason to yield. The returned list is the caller's materialization.
